program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((twos (find-color g 2))
                  (p1 (first twos))
                  (p2 (second twos))
                  (r1 (first p1))
                  (c1 (second p1))
                  (r2 (first p2))
                  (c2 (second p2))
                  (dr (- r2 r1))
                  (dc (- c2 c1))
                  (steps (max (abs dr) (abs dc)))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((i (range 0 (+ steps 1))))
               (let* ((t (if (zero? steps) 0.0 (/ (+ 0.0 i) (+ 0.0 steps))))
                      (r (inexact->exact (round (+ r1 (* t dr)))))
                      (c (inexact->exact (round (+ c1 (* t dc))))))
                 (when
                   (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))
                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                     (cond
                       ((zero? v) (hash-set! result (list r c) 2))
                       ((= v 1) (hash-set! result (list r c) 3)))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
          (twos (find-color g 2)) (p1 (first twos)) (p2 (second twos))
          (r1 (first p1)) (c1 (second p1)) (r2 (first p2)) (c2 (second p2))
          (dr (- r2 r1)) (dc (- c2 c1))
          (steps (max (abs dr) (abs dc)))
          (result (make-hash)) (hit #f))
     (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
       (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
     (for ((i (range 0 (+ steps 1))))
       (let* ((t (if (zero? steps) 0.0 (/ (+ 0.0 i) (+ 0.0 steps))))
              (r (inexact->exact (round (+ r1 (* t dr)))))
              (c (inexact->exact (round (+ c1 (* t dc))))))
         (when (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))
           (let ((v (at g r c)))
             (when (and (not hit) (= v 1)) (set! hit (list r c)))
             (cond ((zero? v) (hash-set! result (list r c) 2))
                   ((= v 1) (hash-set! result (list r c) 3)))))))
     (let ((line (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))
       (when hit
         (for ((obj (objects g 0)))
           (when (and (= (obj-color obj) 1) (member hit (obj-cells obj)))
             (set! line (paint-cells line (obj-cells obj) 3)))))
       line))))
